Good Example

This page exists so the audit tool has a known-good target. It describes a small business technology service in enough plain language that a reader understands who it is for, what they receive, how setup works and what happens next.

The page links to a friendly service page and to the French version. Those targets exist in the build, so the internal-link check should pass. The canonical URL is the page itself and the hreflang set is reciprocal with the French page.

There is one image below. It has alt text and intrinsic dimensions. There is no render-blocking stylesheet or synchronous script in the head, no invalid JSON-LD, and no accidental duplicate title. The page is intentionally calm and specific rather than keyword stuffed.
